titulo.alumno:
«Отглагольные существительные и управление»
Verbal nouns and government

intro: Derived nouns condense actions: обсуждать проблему → обсуждение проблемы; analysing the government helps interpret the sentence.

piezas.titulo: Derived nouns condense actions: обсуждать проблему → обсуждение проблемы; analysing the government helps interpret the sentence.
texto: Derived nouns condense actions: обсуждать проблему → обсуждение проблемы; analysing the government helps interpret the sentence.
When nominalising, some complements change form: обсуждать проект, обсуждение проекта.

frases.alumno: After completing the review, they approved the publication.
The debate about the project lasted several weeks.

pregunta.texto: Which form expresses the nominalised process of обсуждать?

opciones.explicacion: Обсуждение is the noun naming the process of debating.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «После завершения проверки публикацию одобрили.»

opciones.texto: After completing the review, they approved the publication.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: The debate about the project lasted several weeks.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: The debate about the project lasted several weeks.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
